    • ByteFieldCodec

      protected ByteFieldCodec(int byteWidth, ByteOrder byteOrder, boolean signed)
      Creates a fixed-width relocation field codec.
      Parameters:
      byteWidth - field width in bytes; must be a power of two between 1 and 8
      byteOrder - byte order used to encode/decode the field
      signed - whether the field should be interpreted as signed on read
